dz: 阿莱克西奥斯一世·科姆内诺斯推翻了拜占庭皇帝尼克福罗斯三世·博塔内亚特斯,在他出兵三天后广泛掠夺君士坦丁堡后,于4月4日被正式加冕.
de: Alexios I Komnenos overthrows the Byzantine emperor Nikephoros III Botaneiates, and, after his troops spend three days extensively looting Constantinople, is formally crowned on April 4.

t: 诺曼人在代尔哈齐姆战役中击败了拜占庭帝国.
te: The Normans defeat the Byzantine Empire in the Battle of Dyrrhachium.
